title: The Importance of the Intellect and Sound Thinking in the Tarbiyah of Children

text_simplified: This text discusses the importance of the intellect and sound thinking, noting that the intellect is the foundation of taklif (moral and legal responsibility) and accountability. It also clarifies that righteous deeds and charity are only accepted when they stem from a conscious intellect. It emphasizes the necessity of nurturing children in sound thinking from a young age.

review_defects.arabic: الأعمال الصالحة والصدقة تكون مقبولة إذا صدرت عن عقل واعٍ
review_defects.english: righteous deeds and charity are only accepted when they stem from a conscious intellect
review_defects.why: The English adds 'only', implying exclusivity, whereas the Arabic simply states they are accepted if from a conscious intellect, without restricting acceptance to that condition alone.
The same Arabic term 'تربية' is transliterated as 'Tarbiyah' in the title but translated as 'nurturing' in the body, creating inconsistency within the document.
